description: nf-core/atacseq samplesheet context. Designed for direct creation of the pipeline CSV from study metadata + ENA-resolved FASTQ URLs.

pipeline.name: nf-core/atacseq
pipeline.core_rule: Required header columns are: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, replicate. Additional metadata columns may follow.

validation_rules: Column 1 must be `sample`; the sample value should be a stable biological identifier shared across replicates.
fastq_1/fastq_2 may be HTTPS URLs (ENA mirror) or local paths.
replicate is a 1-indexed integer; multiple rows per sample with different replicate values describe biological replicates.
Single-end libraries leave fastq_2 blank but retain the column header.

population_priority: One row per (biological sample, replicate, run).
Use accession_rows from the resolver context to populate fastq_1/fastq_2.
Carry NExtSEEK metadata into treatment/tissue/donor/condition/antibody columns when present.
